name: Toro (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of light blue and white within a pale grey-white border, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Toro.
history: Municipal flag of Toro, a municipality in the department of Valle del Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Toro arms — quartered red and white with a crown
